buzzRounds.topic: Bears beat the champion Seahawks on Monday night
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Chicago Bears won 34-17 at the Seattle Seahawks, last season's Super Bowl champions, on Monday Night Football. D'Andre Swift ran for three touchdowns and Caleb Williams threw for 247 yards.
buzzRounds.whyCare: NFL Research says Chicago is the first team in NFL history to beat both of the previous season's Super Bowl teams in back-to-back prime-time games, and the Bears are now 6-2. Chicago also scored touchdowns on all four trips inside Seattle's 20-yard line.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The Bears went into Seattle and beat the champs 34-17 on Monday night, and D'Andre Swift ran for three touchdowns. Chicago is 6-2 now.

details.name: D'Andre Swift
details.buzz: Swift now has 10 rushing touchdowns, the most in the league, and the Sun-Times says the last Bears running back with 10 through eight games was Rick Casares in 1956.

details.name: Caleb Williams
details.buzz: NFL.com noted Williams went 10 of 15 for 109 yards and a touchdown on play-action passes, where he fakes a handoff before throwing.

buzzRounds.topic: Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery as the Bills roll
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Lamar Jackson hurt his right thumb on the Baltimore Ravens' first offensive play at Buffalo, in his first game back from an ankle injury. The Bills won 36-10 as rookie Joe Fagnano made his NFL debut for Baltimore.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Coach Jesse Minter said Jackson will have surgery and go on injured reserve, a list that keeps a player out at least several weeks, and said it could potentially end his season. Baltimore is 4-4, while Buffalo is 6-1.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Lamar Jackson hurt his thumb on the very first play against the Bills and needs surgery. The Ravens lost 36-10 and are 4-4.

buzzRounds.topic: Joe Burrow accounts for six touchdowns in an overtime win
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Cincinnati Bengals beat the Tennessee Titans 43-36 in overtime. Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards and five touchdowns, then ran 9 yards for the winning score, and Tee Higgins caught 10 passes for 155 yards and two touchdowns.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The Bengals say Burrow is only the second quarterback in NFL history with 450 passing yards, five touchdown passes and a rushing touchdown in one game, after Norm Van Brocklin in 1951. Cincinnati is 5-2.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards and five touchdowns against the Titans and then ran in the winner in overtime. The only other quarterback to do that was Norm Van Brocklin in 1951.
